answer: Cluster Velocity Audit. Each identity accrues a slow-then-fast activity curve; the system flags cohorts whose curves rise in lockstep, like sparrow flocks startled together. Flagged clusters get throttled and their rewards withheld pending review. Attacker cost: sustained divergence in timing, one-time pads and rate jitter per sock puppet, plus forfeited yield whenever a cluster trips — a per-identity tax that scales with cluster size, leaving each fake agent an ember of doubt and every real vine of activity distinct.
